_extract.note: Complete reverse-audit extract for the CircleCI five-pack suite. Every official API v2 method/path operation is admitted; the root preserves all 25 shipped IDs and wire routes.
_extract.unpaged_collection_note: These collection-shaped reads have no complete page-token request/next_page_token response pair in the pinned OpenAPI. They remain one-dispatch calls and are never mislabeled single_page.
